tool_analysis:
Step Analysis: The recorded session logs show navigating to Magento Admin, handling potential login, closing a notification popup, using various filters in the Manage Customers grid (ID range, name/email, group, country, date range, website, active flag), clicking Search and Reset Filter, adjusting pagination, and confirming grid results with Edit links. The earlier failure was due to an unreliable Reset Filter selector (button[title='Reset Filter']); this run identified stable indices and implied underlying attributes for Search and Reset Filter.

Task Definition: Build a reusable tool that, given filter parameters and pagination options, opens the Magento Manage Customers grid, ensures the session is valid (with a safe fallback login), applies the specified filters, submits the search, optionally navigates to a requested page and adjusts page size, and finally extracts the resulting customer grid data including Edit links.

Action Plan:
1) Navigate directly to the Manage Customers grid URL.
2) Wait for the page; if redirected to login, use stable login field IDs to authenticate and wait for redirect back to grid.
3) Close the notification popup via a robust selector if it appears so it does not block controls.
4) Fill in filter inputs: ID From/To, Name/Email, Telephone, ZIP, State, Customer Since From/To.
5) Set filter dropdowns: Group, Country, Website, Active Any/Yes/No, using visible option text.
6) Click the Search button using a robust selector (title='Search' and grid JS object) to apply all filters.
7) Wait for the grid to refresh.
8) If pagination inputs are provided, set the page number in the pager field and press Enter; if page_size is provided, change the View per page dropdown accordingly and wait for refresh.
9) Extract the full customer grid (headers, total count, pager text, and row details including Edit link URLs) and return as structured content.

Variable Identification: Inputs directly correspond to Magento filter element names or roles: entity_id_from/entity_id_to (ID range), name_email (Name/Email filter), group (customer group dropdown text), telephone, zip, country (country dropdown text), state, customer_since_from/to (date range), website (website dropdown text), is_active (Any/Yes/No dropdown), page (pager input value), page_size (View per page selector). All are optional because the Magento UI allows running a search with any combination; the tool should support flexible filtering without forcing values.

Step Optimization: The tool uses direct navigation to the customer grid URL instead of menu clicks. Stable, semantic selectors are preferred over index-based ones, using IDs and attribute-based locators inferred from Magento conventions and the UI (e.g., #customerGrid_filter_entity_id_from, button[title='Search']). The previous brittle Reset Filter wait step is not used; instead, only Search is essential to apply filters, while Reset Filter is not required for the core tool behavior and thus omitted. Popup closing is handled once by a robust selector that resolves to a single element when present. Pagination is managed via the pager input and View dropdown using flexible selectors. Agentic steps are unnecessary because all key interactions can be scripted deterministically with these selectors.
name: tool_search_customers_v2
description: Search Magento customers in the Admin Manage Customers grid using flexible filters (ID range, name/email, group, telephone, ZIP, country, state, customer-since date range, website, active flag) plus pagination, then return the resulting grid including Edit links.

steps.description: Navigate directly to the Magento Admin Manage Customers grid URL (authentication assumed to be already established).
Wait for the Manage Customers grid and filters to fully load after navigation or redirect from login.
(Fallback login) Input Magento admin username into the login form if it appears; harmless if field is absent.
(Fallback login) Input Magento admin password into the login form if it appears; harmless if field is absent.
(Fallback login) Click the 'Log in to Admin Panel' submit button if the login page is shown. Ignored on grid if button not present.
Wait for redirect from login to Manage Customers grid to complete.
Close the Magento notification popup window if it is present, using a robust selector for the close link.
Set lower bound of customer ID range filter (From field under ID column). Leave empty if no value provided.
Set upper bound of customer ID range filter (To field under ID column). Leave empty if no value provided.
Set Name / Email text filter to match customer name or email. Leave empty if not provided.
Set customer Group dropdown filter to the specified visible text option if provided.
Set Telephone filter value if provided.
Set ZIP/postcode filter value if provided.
Set Country filter dropdown to the specified visible text option if provided.
Set State/Province filter text if provided (field may be an input depending on configuration).
Set Customer Since From date using MM/DD/YYYY format if provided.
Set Customer Since To date using MM/DD/YYYY format if provided.
Set Website dropdown filter to the specified visible text option if provided.
Set active Any/Yes/No filter dropdown if provided.
Click the Search button in the grid toolbar to apply all configured filters.
Wait for the grid to refresh and display filtered customer results.
If a page number is provided, set the pager Page input to that number to navigate to a specific page.
After changing the page number, press Enter in the pager Page input to load the requested page.
If page_size is provided, change the View per page dropdown to adjust page size.
Wait for the grid to refresh after pagination or page size changes.
Capture the resulting customer grid data and metadata after applying filters and pagination so it can be returned to the caller.
steps.goal: Extract the visible customers grid including header labels, current filter values, total records text, pager information, and for each row: ID, Name, Email, Group, Telephone, ZIP, Country, State/Province, Customer Since, Website, and Edit link href.

input_schema.name: entity_id_from
input_schema.description: Lower bound of customer ID range filter (From under ID column, input name like 'customerGrid_filter_entity_id[from]').

input_schema.name: entity_id_to
input_schema.description: Upper bound of customer ID range filter (To under ID column, input name like 'customerGrid_filter_entity_id[to]').

input_schema.name: name_email
input_schema.description: Text for Name / Email filter field to match customer name or email (input in Name/Email column).

input_schema.name: group
input_schema.description: Visible text of customer Group filter dropdown option (e.g., 'General', 'Wholesale', 'VIP Member', 'Private Sales Member').

input_schema.name: telephone
input_schema.description: Telephone number filter value (Telephone column text input).

input_schema.name: zip
input_schema.description: ZIP/postcode filter value (ZIP column text input).

input_schema.name: country
input_schema.description: Visible text of Country filter dropdown option (e.g., 'All Countries', 'United States').

input_schema.name: state
input_schema.description: State/Province filter value (text input or select, typically region name or code).

input_schema.name: customer_since_from
input_schema.description: Start date for Customer Since date range filter (From field, expects date format MM/DD/YYYY).

input_schema.name: customer_since_to
input_schema.description: End date for Customer Since date range filter (To field, expects date format MM/DD/YYYY).

input_schema.name: website
input_schema.description: Visible text of Website filter dropdown option (e.g., 'Admin', 'Main Website').

input_schema.name: is_active
input_schema.description: Active status filter dropdown in first column (options 'Any', 'Yes', 'No').

input_schema.name: page
input_schema.description: Page number to navigate to via pager control at top of grid (e.g., '1', '2').

input_schema.name: page_size
input_schema.description: Number of records per page to select in 'View' page size dropdown (e.g., '20','30','50','100','200').
